db/read#

Reading values out of rows: one reader per column, with the conversions db/row offers, and Maybe and Presence for NULL and missing columns.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Reading values out of rows: one reader per column, with the conversions db/row offers, and Maybe and Presence for NULL and missing columns. Row uses it.

Public API#

role RowValues#

role RowValues

Narrow input protocol keeps readers independent of the Row implementation.

RowValues.value#

value(name is string) is DbValue

The value of a column.

object DbPage#

object DbPage

A page of rows fetched by a native driver, as plain values: rows read their cells by offset without a native call or an object per cell. Kinds use the native cell codes; a value is the integer of an integer cell, else the ordinal of the cell in its typed array. Width 0: no page (generic rows).
